scope: Nynorsk support and shared renderers (0.6.0), physical-power readings (0.6.1), PDF-wide unit inventory (0.7.0), and scientific-number support with unit-context and temperature regression tests (0.8.0, 2026-11-13). Historical investigation remains in SOURCES.md. Reading preferences, plain symbol currency names and abbreviation aliases updated in 0.9.0 (2026-11-13). Optional English aliases and ambiguous-t review updated in 0.10.0 (2026-11-13).
implementation_credit: National Library of Norway, Språkmodeller, with OpenAI Codex assistance.
limitations: Hashes verify inspected bytes and artifact identity, not authorship, linguistic correctness, native-speaker review, acoustic performance or continued upstream availability. Mutable reference-only pages are not immutable snapshots.

scientific-ndla.title: NDLA: Tierpotenser og tall på standardform
scientific-ndla.role: Primary teaching reference: integer powers of ten, standard form and calculator E notation. Inspected web extraction; mutable reference-only, not byte-pinned or redistributed. Speech templates and ambiguity bounds are project policy.

scientific-matematikk.title: Matematikk.org: Tall på standardform
scientific-matematikk.role: Primary teaching reference for standard form and negative exponents; inspected web extraction, reference-only, no upstream text/code copied.

scientific-mattehefte.title: Mattehefte: Hvordan skrive tall på standardform?
scientific-mattehefte.role: Supplied teaching reference corroborating decimal-comma standard form. First fetch failed; retry via non-www returned redirected web extraction. Reference-only, no retrieved source-byte hash or redistributed content.

scientific-wikibooks.title: Wikibooks: Norwegian/Numbers
scientific-wikibooks.role: Supplied secondary cross-check, inspected current page identifying this revision; not normative. Historical spellings and orthographic claims not adopted; no table/text copied. Revision reference, not byte-pinned.

scientific-decimals.title: Språkrådet: Tall, tid og dato
scientific-decimals.role: Primary decimal-comma and noun-agreement guidance, inspected web search extraction; mutable reference-only. Machine decimal-point acceptance and bounded exact unit agreement are project policy.

scientific-policy.title: First-party scientific-number and name-initial disambiguation proposal
scientific-policy.role: Project policy in SOURCES.md#scientific-number-proposal-2026-11-13, approved for publication on 2026-11-13. Signed cardinal exponent readings, syntax bounds, identifier/currency/range review, and numeric-context/name-initial guard are project choices. No acoustic validation claimed.

nn-grammar.title: Nynorsksenteret: Nynorsk grammatikk, Ordklasser og setningar
nn-grammar.role: Printed page 36: number forms; grammatical reference only, no document or upstream algorithm redistributed.

nn-abbreviations.title: Språkrådet: Forkortelser
nn-abbreviations.role: Abbreviation meanings read through the web interface; mutable reference-only page, not vendored or hash-pinned.

project-policy.title: Project-authored Nynorsk reading policy
project-policy.role: Variant selection, gender propagation, natural decimal speech, context aliases, proper-name preservation, spellings and scope; not an external normative source.

government-unit-draft.title: Forskrift om målenheter og måling: government-hosted historical draft
government-unit-draft.role: Table 3, printed page 4: acceleration uses sekund i annen; area and volume use kvadratmeter/kubikkmeter. Inspected through web PDF text. First page has [dato] 2007; historical wording evidence only, not current law or SI definitions. Direct byte retrieval returned HTTP 403; no immutable snapshot or content hash claimed.

sprakradet-ordinals.title: Språkrådet: Tall, tid og dato, Andre og annen
sprakradet-ordinals.role: Bokmål permits both ordinal andre and annen; Nynorsk uses andre. Project selects i annen for squared non-length units in Bokmål and i andre in Nynorsk; ordinary ordinal readings and geometric names stay unchanged. Mutable reference-only page.

government-unit-pdf-bytes.title: Forskrift om målenheter og måling: direct historical government PDF
government-unit-pdf-bytes.role: Direct PDF located via official search after the redirect had returned HTTP 403. Full 76-page text audited for unit notation; tables 1-9 and later flow quantities mapped in pdf_unit_inventory.json; printed page 6 visually inspected. Historical [dato] 2007 draft, not current law or SI definitions. No document bundled. Bytes retrieved with curl; Python urllib re-fetch currently receives HTTP 403 and the optional audit reports that failure.

cldr-no-49.title: Unicode CLDR 49: common/main/no.xml
cldr-no-49.role: Selected Norwegian unit-name metadata: bueminutt/bueminutter, buesekund/buesekunder, nautical miles, carat and mercury pressure; no upstream XML, inheritance engine or formatting implementation bundled.
cldr-no-49.notice: Copyright 2001–2026 Unicode, Inc.; LICENSES/Unicode-3.0.txt and NOTICE.

reading-preferences.title: Project-requested reading preferences and tolerated abbreviation aliases
reading-preferences.role: First-party policy: paired contextual years, configurable single-letter unit readings, plain dollar/yuan names for bare symbols, and explicit missing-dot/time-unit aliases. Existing primary numeral, grammar, abbreviation and unit sources remain applicable; no new upstream implementation or dataset copied.

time-alias-policy.title: Norwegian time abbreviations and conservative alias policy
time-alias-policy.role: Re-inspected web reference: min, s/sek, t meaning both time and tonn, and km/t/km/h. Mutable reference-only, no byte hash or copied implementation. Default-off English time aliases and free-text t review are first-party policy documented in SOURCES.md.
